decisions.reason: Operator training supports our machinery and customer relationships, and no evidence suggests it is failing.
Fourth rotary axis is a standard accessory for CNC machines and likely remains in demand.
Hybrid additive post-processing is a newer offering but additive manufacturing is growing, so we keep it for now.
High-speed CNC milling machine is a core product with dedicated promotion and strong market fit.
Automatic tool change system enhances our existing machines and was well presented at launch.
